test_tz_convert: test the DataFrame and Series tz_convert method to convert timezone-aware DatetimeIndex from one timezone to another
test_tz_convert_axis1: test the DataFrame tz_convert method with axis=1 to convert timezone-aware columns to a target timezone
test_tz_convert_naive: test that tz_convert raises TypeError when called on a DataFrame or Series with a tz-naive index
test_tz_convert_and_localize: test tz_convert and tz_localize on DataFrames with DatetimeIndex and MultiIndex at specified levels
test_tz_convert_copy_inplace_mutate: test that tz_convert returns a copy and does not mutate the original DataFrame or Series
